name: Truebit TRU bonding-curve purchase-price overflow
summary: The pre-0.8 Purchase implementation computed the TRU purchase price with unchecked arithmetic. Crafted buy amounts overflowed the price numerator so the ETH cost wrapped to near zero, letting the attacker mint vast TRU (Purchase holds TRU's minter role) and sell it back to the bonding curve, draining its ETH reserve in repeated buy-sell rounds.
notes: The proxy has run this implementation since its constructor; the age runs from the TRU grantRole that made Purchase a minter 14 blocks later (rule 8), without which the free buys could not mint.

105 copycat txs in the next ~1,300 blocks repeated the overflow: getPurchasePrice returned 0 for 16.9B+ TRU, minted for free and sold back for the ~4.2 ETH the anchor left. DEX sales of TRU (e.g. 0xc0454e54) did not touch the curve and are not campaign or loss.

campaign.selection: Successful txs after the anchor that call Purchase 0x764c64b2 buyTRU (0xa0296215) for over 1M TRU with getPurchasePrice overflowing to ~0 ETH and sell it back (0xc471b10b) in the same tx; senders 0x3a061967 (via contracts), c0ffeebabe and 0x4ed29d99
